candidates.title: [RFC]: Opt-in return of the last hidden state at sampled positions, per request (Model Runner V2)
candidates.snippet: ### Motivation.  A growing class of deployments puts a small trained head on top of a served model: a linear probe, a per-task classifier over a fixed label set, a calibration layer. Such a head needs two things from one forward pass: the model's scores for a few tokens, and the hidden state those scores were computed from. vLLM returns the first (logprobs, `logprob_token_ids`) but not the second. candidates.snippet: ### Motivation.  **Reference baseline:** vLLM v0.30.0  We propose an optional, reusable KV compression capability in vLLM for KV transfer and storage. KVServe manages the compression workflow, including algorithm composition, profile selection, and encoding/decoding. Mooncake P/D transfer is the first integration. candidates.title: [Performance]: Default CUDA GDN wrapper regresses non-spec Qwen3.5 throughput on H200
candidates.snippet: ## Summary  Pure non-speculative Qwen3.5 decode still enters the CUDA-labelled packed fused-norm wrapper even though the fused CUDA recurrent kernel only accepts speculative/MTP batches. On two H200s, selecting the standard Triton path instead improved output throughput by **30-35%** under two prefix-cache policies.
